messages:
nina_cs: FYI: NewHorizon goes into dedicated pool prime tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need final confirmation on reserved quota, autoscale bounds, and who owns the loadtest execution.

omar_se: i can confirm quota. requesting 8 GPU units (A100-equivalent). will push the request to finance in 30m.

kevin_ops: proposed autoscale: min=2, target=8, burst_max=24, scale_step=4, cool_down=60s. suggest a 20m canary first.

nina_cs: canary OK. ramp plan: prime cache for 15m, then 0->25rps over 15m, sustain 25rps for 2h with two 5m spikes to 100rps. collect model quality flags during spikes.

tess_sre: i'll wire the canary and alerting. breach policy: if p95 > 300ms OR error_rate > 1% for 5m -> run rollback. rollback = shift 30% to hosted and pause autoscale.

ada_support: onboarding checklist: customer access to logs confirmed, post-run survey ready, and we need the customer's acceptance criteria doc (nina, do you have it?).

nina_cs: got it, sending acceptance criteria DM now. key gates: p95 < 250ms, error_rate <= 0.5%, no more than 2 regressions on the eval prompt set.

quota-bot: reminder: quota hold will auto-release in 24h unless finance approves. Link: https://finance.internal/requests/NR-4821

omar_se: loadtest commands (use bench-v2):
```
bench-v2 --target https://dedicated.redwood/newhorizon --rps 25 --clients 80 --duration 7200
bench-v2 --target https://dedicated.redwood/newhorizon --rps 100 --clients 300 --duration 300 # spike
prime-prefix --target https://dedicated.redwood/newhorizon --file prefixes.txt --concurrency 30
```

kevin_ops: ops tags: @tess_sre @omar_se @ada_support. can we add a short chaos check at 1h mark to simulate node OOM? want to test fallback routing.

tess_sre: yes. i'll schedule a controlled instance restart at +1h and monitor failover.

ada_support: i'll run the quality prompt set at +4h and post a short results summary to the thread.

nina_cs: post-run deliverables: 1) short SLA summary (uptime, observed p50/p95), 2) recommended SLA tier, 3) run artifacts and survey results. omar, can you draft the SLA note within 2 hours after run end?

omar_se: yes will do.

quota-bot: loadtest scheduled: 2026-05-02T03:00:00Z -> 2026-05-02T07:00:00Z. artifacts will be uploaded to https://artifacts.redwood.ai/newhorizon/warmup-2026-05-02.log

nina_cs: thanks everyone  i'll compile and send to NewHorizon CSM after run. :rocket:
